Q: Rate-limiting python decorator A:

A decorator-based rate limiter works for single-process code, but it breaks as soon as you have multiple workers or hosts (each process keeps its own counter).

If you need the limit to be global, the decorator must rely on a shared backend (Redis or a database).

One option is Rate Sync:

https://pypi.org/project/rate-sync/

Example: decorator with a global (distributed) rate limit

# rate-sync.toml
[stores.redis]
engine = "redis"
url = "redis://localhost:6379/0"

[limiters.api]
store = "redis"
rate_per_second = 5.0

from ratesync import rate_limited

@rate_limited("api")
def call_api():
    # external API call
    pass

Unlike in-memory decorators, this enforces the limit across all processes and hosts, not just within a single Python process.

Q: How to bypass being rate limited ..HTML Error 1015 using Python A:

Cloudflare Error 1015 means you’re being rate-limited by the site. You can’t bypass it legitimately; the fix is to slow down and reduce concurrency.

If you need throttling that works across multiple processes/hosts, use a shared backend (Redis/PostgreSQL).

One option is Rate Sync: https://pypi.org/project/rate-sync/

# rate-sync.toml
[stores.redis]
engine = "redis"
url = "redis://localhost:6379/0"

[limiters.cloudflare]
store = "redis"
rate_per_second = 0.2   # 1 req / 5s
max_concurrent = 1

from ratesync import acquire
import httpx

async def fetch(url):
    async with acquire("cloudflare"):
        async with httpx.AsyncClient() as c:
            r = await c.get(url)
            r.raise_for_status()
            return r.text

Q: Select Case malfunction with V W X Y and Z? A:

Your original code seems to work, but the following seems simpler using VBA's Like operator

Function AlphaNumericOnly(strSource As String) As String
  'takes special characters out of the string when called (folder name)
  
  Dim i As Integer
  Dim strResult As String
  Dim S As String * 1

strSource = Trim(strSource)


    For i = 1 To Len(strSource) 'check each character
        S = Mid(strSource, i)
        If S Like "[ 0-9A-Za-z]" Then strResult = strResult & S
    Next i
    
AlphaNumericOnly = strResult
        
End Function

Q: How to limit rate of requests to web services in Python? A:

If you only run a single process, a simple in-memory throttle (sleep, token bucket, etc.) may be enough.

But as soon as you have multiple workers or multiple hosts, in-memory rate limiting breaks down.

To enforce a global rate limit, all workers must coordinate through a shared state (Redis or a database). Otherwise each process applies its own limit and you still overload the external service.

One option that implements this pattern is rate-sync:

https://pypi.org/project/rate-sync/

Example: global rate limit shared across all workers

# rate-sync.toml

[stores.redis]
engine = "redis"
url = "redis://localhost:6379/0"

[limiters.external_service]
store = "redis"
rate_per_second = 5.0

from ratesync import acquire
import httpx

async def call_service(payload):
    await acquire("external_service")  # enforced globally
    async with httpx.AsyncClient() as client:
        return await client.post("https://api.example.com", json=payload)

Q: Logging the Inner User-Name from EAP-TTLS Requests with linelog A: 
Nos vídeos abaixo, você vai aprender a configurar autenticação EAP-TLS utilizando PKI / ADCS, integrada ao Active Directory (LDAP) com FreeRADIUS, criando uma solução segura, escalável e totalmente Open Source para redes corporativas.
